## NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra API

NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra is a large language model by NVIDIA, available on the Venice API as `nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b`. This model is private and no prompt data is stored in any capacity.

NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra is built for frontier reasoning, orchestration, coding agents, deep research, and complex enterprise workflows. It delivers up to 5x faster inference and up to 30% lower cost for agentic workloads.

### How to use the NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions` with `"model": "nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b"` and your API key.

```bash
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "nvidia-nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b",
    "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain TEE attestation in two sentences." }],
    "reasoning_effort": "low"
  }'
```
